verdict.rationale: Blaxel ships a first-party skill that lets a user's agent deploy agents, create sandboxes, host MCP servers and run batch jobs "using simple prompts, zero code required" (blaxel-docs-1, blaxel-docs-15). An official MCP server (blaxel-probe-3) and per-sandbox MCP tool interfaces (blaxel-docs-38) back this natural-language operation, and llms.txt (blaxel-probe-1) supports agent consumption. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that prompt-driven operation works end to end, documentation of the skill's full command coverage and limits, and evidence of a native natural-language interface beyond an external agent.
